question: A company makes two products A and B. Each unit of product A requires 2 hours in machine I and 1 hour in machine II. Each unit of B requires 1 hour in machine I and 2 hours in machine II. Machine I is available for at most 10 hours per day and Machine II is available for at most 8 hours per day. The profit on each unit of A is Rs 30 and on B is Rs 50. Formulate the LPP, graph the feasible region, find all corner points, and determine the production plan for maximum profit.

options.A: Produce 4 units of A and 2 units of B; maximum profit Rs 220
options.B: Produce 0 units of A and 4 units of B; maximum profit Rs 200
options.C: Produce 5 units of A and 0 units of B; maximum profit Rs 150
options.D: Produce 0 units of A and 0 units of B; maximum profit Rs 0
